title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 30th (AAPL, BFST, BRY, CCBG, CE, CLR, DLG, DOV, EL, ILMN)
text:
Posted by Lisa Pomrenke on Jan 30th, 2019 // No Comments
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Wednesday, January 30th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $160.00 target price by analysts at HSBC Holdings plc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Business First Bancshares (NASDAQ:BFST) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Stephens. They currently have a $29.00 target price on the stock. Berry Petroleum (NASDAQ:BRY) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. The firm currently has a $12.00 price target on the stock.
Capital City Bank Group (NASDAQ:CCBG) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Stephens. Stephens currently has a $25.00 price target on the stock.
Celanese (NYSE:CE) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $120.00 target price on the stock.
Continental Resources (NYSE:CLR) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $62.00 target price on the stock.
Dialog Semiconductor (ETR:DLG) was given a €29.50 ($34.30) target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Dover (NYSE:DOV) had its target price boosted by SunTrust Banks, Inc. from $5.68 to $91.00. SunTrust Banks, Inc. currently has a hold rating on the stock. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
Estee Lauder Companies (NYSE:EL) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. They currently have a $153.00 price target on the stock.
Illumina (NASDAQ:ILMN) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a $355.00 price target on the stock.
Juniper Networks (NYSE:JNPR) had its target price cut by Royal Bank of Canada to $26.00. Royal Bank of Canada currently has a sector perform rating on the stock.
Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Bank of America Corp. Bank of America Corp currently has a $390.00 target price on the stock.
Meritor (NYSE:MTOR) had its target price increased by Royal Bank of Canada to $22.00. Royal Bank of Canada currently has a sector perform rating on the stock. They noted that the move was a valuation call. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
Prosperity Bancshares (NYSE:PB) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Stephens. Stephens currently has a $73.00 price target on the stock.
Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. BMO Capital Markets currently has a $195.00 target price on the stock.
Silicon Laboratories (NASDAQ:SLAB) had its target price trimmed by Benchmark Co. from $110.00 to $100.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
STMicroelectronics (EPA:STM) was given a €17.20 ($20.00) target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Siltronic (FRA:WAF) was given a €106.00 ($123.26) price target by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
